items.title: International student cuts risk ‘very significant hole’, universities warn - SMH.com.au
items.commentary: Universities have warned that proposed cuts to international student numbers could create a significant financial gap in the sector. Reduced student intake caps may limit the number of study visas available to prospective international students seeking to enrol in Australian institutions.
items.commentary_pt: Universidades alertaram que os cortes propostos no número de estudantes internacionais podem abrir um rombo financeiro importante no setor. A redução nos limites de vagas pode diminuir a quantidade de vistos de estudo disponíveis para quem pretende se matricular em instituições australianas.

items.title: Coalition MPs concede immigration pledge not fully costed by independent watchdog - The Guardian
items.commentary: Members of the Coalition acknowledged that their migration reduction pledge was not fully costed by the independent budget watchdog. The uncertainty around the plan leaves open questions about how proposed visa and intake changes would be implemented for future applicants.
items.commentary_pt: Parlamentares da Coalizão admitiram que a promessa de reduzir a migração não teve seus custos totalmente avaliados pelo órgão independente de controle orçamentário. A incerteza em torno do plano deixa dúvidas sobre como as mudanças propostas em vistos e cotas seriam aplicadas a futuros solicitantes.

items.title: International students who change courses or universities may have to leave Australia to apply for a visa - SBS
items.commentary: International students who switch courses or change universities may be required to leave Australia to lodge a new visa application. This change would add cost and disruption for students wishing to alter their study plans while already in the country.
items.commentary_pt: Estudantes internacionais que mudarem de curso ou de universidade poderão ser obrigados a sair da Austrália para solicitar um novo visto. A medida aumentaria os custos e os transtornos para quem deseja alterar seus planos de estudo já estando no país.

items.title: Fears of NT business closures after delayed dry season and proposed visa cuts - ABC News & Headlines – Australian Broadcasting Corporation
items.source: ABC News & Headlines – Australian Broadcasting Corporation
items.commentary: Businesses in regional areas have expressed fears of closures following proposed reductions to visa numbers combined with a delayed season. Fewer available work visas could reduce the pool of migrant labour that many regional employers depend on.
items.commentary_pt: Empresas de regiões do interior manifestaram temor de fechamento diante da proposta de redução no número de vistos somada a uma temporada atrasada. A diminuição de vistos de trabalho pode reduzir a mão de obra migrante da qual muitos empregadores dessas áreas dependem.

items.title: VIDEO: Taylor says some aged care works will be affected by visa changes - ABC News & Headlines – Australian Broadcasting Corporation
items.source: ABC News & Headlines – Australian Broadcasting Corporation
items.commentary: Proposed visa changes would affect some aged care workers, according to statements made during policy discussions. Reductions in work visa availability could impact migrants employed in the aged care sector and limit future recruitment from overseas.
items.commentary_pt: Mudanças propostas nos vistos afetariam alguns trabalhadores do setor de cuidados a idosos, segundo declarações feitas em discussões sobre a política. A redução na disponibilidade de vistos de trabalho pode atingir migrantes empregados nesse setor e limitar futuras contratações do exterior.

items.title: How the Coalition's migration numbers compare with Labor's and One Nation's - SBS
items.commentary: A comparison outlines how the migration targets proposed by the Coalition differ from those of Labor and One Nation. The varying numbers signal potential future shifts in how many visas are issued across skilled, student, and family categories.
items.commentary_pt: Uma comparação mostra como as metas de migração propostas pela Coalizão diferem das do Partido Trabalhista e do One Nation. Os números distintos indicam possíveis mudanças futuras na quantidade de vistos concedidos nas categorias de trabalho qualificado, estudo e família.

items.title: Graduate visas face the axe in Coalition migration overhaul - ABC News & Headlines – Australian Broadcasting Corporation
items.source: ABC News & Headlines – Australian Broadcasting Corporation
items.commentary: Graduate visas could be abolished under a proposed migration overhaul by the Coalition. Removing this pathway would affect international graduates who rely on post-study work rights to gain Australian experience and transition to other visas.
items.commentary_pt: Os vistos para recém-formados poderiam ser extintos em uma reforma migratória proposta pela Coalizão. A eliminação dessa via afetaria os formados internacionais que dependem do direito de trabalhar após os estudos para ganhar experiência na Austrália e migrar para outros vistos.

items.title: Coalition’s migration plan risks breaching India free trade agreement and damaging economy, advocates warn - The Guardian
items.commentary: Advocates have warned that the Coalition's proposed migration plan risks breaching the free trade agreement with India and could harm the economy. Any conflict with trade commitments could affect visa arrangements for Indian nationals under the agreement.
items.commentary_pt: Especialistas alertaram que o plano de migração proposto pela Coalizão corre o risco de violar o acordo de livre comércio com a Índia e poderia prejudicar a economia. Qualquer conflito com os compromissos comerciais poderia afetar as regras de visto para cidadãos indianos previstas no acordo.

items.title: Here's how Labor, the Coalition and One Nation's migration cuts compare - ABC News & Headlines – Australian Broadcasting Corporation
items.source: ABC News & Headlines – Australian Broadcasting Corporation
items.commentary: A breakdown compares the migration reduction proposals put forward by Labor, the Coalition, and One Nation. The differing policies could translate into significant changes in annual visa intake depending on which approach is adopted.
items.commentary_pt: Uma análise compara as propostas de redução da migração apresentadas pelo Partido Trabalhista, pela Coalizão e pelo One Nation. As diferentes políticas poderiam resultar em mudanças significativas no número anual de vistos, dependendo de qual abordagem for adotada.

items.title: Taylor enters three-way migration battle with 100,000 target as Labor and One Nation fire back - SMH.com.au
items.commentary: A migration debate has intensified after a target of 100,000 was proposed, prompting responses from rival parties. A sharply lower intake figure would substantially reduce the number of visas granted across multiple categories each year.
items.commentary_pt: O debate sobre migração se intensificou após a proposta de uma meta de 100 mil, gerando reações dos partidos rivais. Um número de admissões muito mais baixo reduziria substancialmente a quantidade de vistos concedidos em diversas categorias a cada ano.

items.title: Angus Taylor concedes aged care workers would be hit by migration plan - ABC News & Headlines – Australian Broadcasting Corporation
items.source: ABC News & Headlines – Australian Broadcasting Corporation
items.commentary: It was conceded that aged care workers would be affected by the proposed migration plan. A reduction in migration intake could limit the availability of work visas for those seeking employment in the aged care sector.
items.commentary_pt: Admitiu-se que os trabalhadores do setor de cuidados a idosos seriam afetados pelo plano de migração proposto. A redução nas admissões poderia limitar a disponibilidade de vistos de trabalho para quem busca emprego nesse setor.

items.title: What the Coalition's immigration plan means for students and bridging visas - ABC News & Headlines – Australian Broadcasting Corporation
items.source: ABC News & Headlines – Australian Broadcasting Corporation
items.commentary: An analysis explains how the Coalition's immigration plan could affect international students and holders of bridging visas. Proposed changes may alter study pathways and the status of those awaiting visa decisions in Australia.
items.commentary_pt: Uma análise explica como o plano de imigração da Coalizão poderia afetar estudantes internacionais e portadores de vistos-ponte. As mudanças propostas podem alterar as trajetórias de estudo e a situação de quem aguarda decisões sobre seus vistos na Austrália.

items.title: AUDIO: Coalition unveils policy to cut net overseas migration to 100,000 a year - ABC News & Headlines – Australian Broadcasting Corporation
items.source: ABC News & Headlines – Australian Broadcasting Corporation
items.commentary: A policy was unveiled proposing to cut net overseas migration to 100,000 people per year. Such a reduction would significantly lower the number of visas issued and tighten entry across skilled, student, and family streams.
items.commentary_pt: Foi apresentada uma política propondo reduzir a migração líquida para 100 mil pessoas por ano. Essa redução diminuiria consideravelmente o número de vistos emitidos e restringiria a entrada nas categorias de trabalho qualificado, estudo e família.
